_about: The measured figures, kept by whoever maintains the site; the editor cannot open this file, and the check in .github/workflows/editor-content-only.yml refuses any editor change to it. Page text does not read from here: figures in the text are ordinary words. This file has two jobs. It is the measured value the figure consistency check (site/_includes/figurecheck.js) compares the pages against, and it fills in the parts of pages that describe the survey data rather than tell a story: the trails map's layer key and the stops' positions in the structured data. Sources for each figure are in docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, 'Verified data'.
